name: mirage
text: ParlayAPI gap checked: it is by design, not lost coverage. The unpriced spreads and totals (3,032 and 1,500) are halves, quarters and first-five-innings lines, which the app keeps out of full-game prices on purpose so a half line never prices a full game. The other 4,000-odd are player prop types with no stat mapping (a generic 'player_game_props', anytime goal, fantasy points); they are counted and never guessed at. Everything the app prices is reaching it in real time (last frame 0 s ago). Nothing to fix there.
